description: Digital art techniques and modern styles

pixel_art.name: Pixel Art
pixel_art.prompt: pixel-art {prompt} . low-res, blocky, pixel art style, 8-bit graphics, retro gaming aesthetic
pixel_art.negative: sloppy, messy, blurry, noisy, highly detailed, ultra textured, photo, realistic

vector.name: Vector Art
vector.prompt: vector art {prompt} . vivid colors, clean lines, sharp edges, minimalist, precise geometry, smooth curves, bold outlines, crisp shapes, flat colors, graphic design, scalable artwork
vector.negative: photo, photograph, realistic, gradient, textured, noisy, blurry

low_poly.name: Low Poly
low_poly.prompt: low-poly style {prompt} . low-poly game art, polygon mesh, jagged, blocky, wireframe edges, centered composition, geometric
low_poly.negative: noisy, sloppy, messy, grainy, highly detailed, ultra textured, photo, realistic

neon.name: Neon Glow
neon.prompt: neon glow art {prompt} . dynamic, dramatic, vibrant neon colors, glowing effects, luminescent, electric, bright rim light, high contrast
neon.negative: ugly, deformed, noisy, blurry, low contrast, muted, dark

cel_shaded.name: Cel Shaded
cel_shaded.prompt: cel shaded art {prompt} . 2D, flat color, toon shading, cel shaded style, bold outlines, anime-inspired, clean edges
cel_shaded.negative: ugly, deformed, noisy, blurry, low contrast, realistic, photographic, gradient shading
